versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.

- No file changes detected.
- No updates to SKILL.md content except a minor fix: corrected typo in the reference2video options, changing 'character1' to 'character2' for the second file reference.
- No new features or bug fixes introduced.

- Added support for reference-to-video (reference2video) generation, allowing creation of videos from reference images and/or videos.
- New options for reference2video: reference files (image/video URLs), resolution, and shot type (single or multi).
- Documentation enhanced with usage examples and option descriptions for the new reference2video feature.
- No existing features changed; update adds new capabilities without breaking backward compatibility.
- Added API documentation reference file.

Initial release of wan-image-video-generation-editting.

- Adds text-to-image, image editing (with prompts), text-to-video, and image-to-video generation using Wan models from Alibaba.
- Supports flexible image and video resolutions, quantity options, and both URL/local file inputs for images.
- Provides detailed CLI instructions for all capabilities.
- Requires a DashScope API key for operation.
